sources.notes: Three records supplied by the project owner. CONFIRMED preserves the supplied physical-verification claim, not independent review by this site. Original publication links and redacted proof files were not supplied; pending entries remain unconfirmed.
Primary developer README documents public firmware support from 7.00 to 13.60. Only support metadata is transcribed. No exploit source code or third-party serial database is copied.

Official support identifies CFI-1000 and CFI-2000/7000 model groups. Sony's linked PS5 starter guide identifies CFI-7000 as Pro. Each model rule carries its supporting source; later CFI-2116 and CFI-7121 matches use only the supplied Modi records. Model recognition alone provides no factory firmware evidence.
